execution.description: SPUR Compute added as Graphite's second inference provider beside Engy, Graphite-only, with an empty rate table, a grant binding and the same selection, reservation, settlement, admission, deadline and transport path.

expected: A second provider plugs in through the same selection and settlement path, and a SPUR run is refused, typed, until the owner records rates and binds a grant.
observed: Same-name models are the trap: SPUR serves glm-5.2 like Engy, and the context table, ladder index and ladder store were all keyed by model name alone, so a SPUR glm-5.2 would have borrowed Engy's 262,144-token context. The Launchpad also reads the shared adapter list, so a provider meant for Carbon's own testing had to live in a registry no miner surface reads.
keep: A provider is a set of parts (adapters, rates, ladder, contexts, key file, refusals) behind one path; tests run the same assertions for every provider.
An empty rate table is shipped as empty and refused by a typed code, never filled with an estimate.
change: Key every provider fact by provider and model (spur:glm-5.2), never by model name alone.
Pin the miner-facing provider list's digest whenever a development-only provider is added.
